collection.title: Saab 9-5 Estate 2008 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Saab 9-5 Estate 2008 to 2012 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Bayonet arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this 9-5, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
